description: Portrait of O'Keeffe standing next to the driver's seat of a convertible car; hair is pulled back from face, wearing a loose rolled collar light-colored jacket tied at the waist over a matching top with a silver dome-shaped pin at the neck, head is turned slightly to viewer left, she looks at the camera with an neutral gaze;  framed in the composition is a  section of the windshield, steering wheel and front seat, trees and sky visible behind the car.
title: Georgia O'Keeffe
